figures.title: Compare the two quantities and explain the difference in your own words
figures.text:
There are 4 apples and 6 oranges. How many more oranges are there?

Explain how the bars support your answer, then check the difference by subtraction.

Keep the labels "Apples" & "Oranges" with their values.

4 < 6, so the orange bar is taller. Read both bars from the same baseline.
A long unbroken label also wraps: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz

6 − 4 = 2. There are 2 more oranges than apples.

The difference compares the counts; it does not give their total.
Swedish text is preserved too: äpplen, päron, blåbär.
